Modeled Revision as an opaque caller-defined u64 rather than adding a generic parameter, keeping the empty [dependencies] table. Refactored check()/check_revision()/check_cancellable() onto one private check_impl to avoid duplicating the scan/suggest logic; check()'s public signature and behavior are unchanged and all rev 1 tests still pass unmodified.
